name: ELITE

source.normalized_paragraph: ELITE is our healthspan intervention trial at Sheba Medical Center, conducted with the Sheba Longevity Center under the principal investigator Dr Evelyne Bischof. The protocol pairs physician-supervised intervention with deep longitudinal phenotyping: scheduled bloodwork, multiomics, microbiome sampling, validated functional and cognitive endpoints, and digital monitoring across the trial arc.
